scope: Safe per-choice/full-extension failure diagnostics only; no product behavior changes
failure_boundary: Per-choice extension reload and restoration exceptions were discarded by nested catches, leaving T04/T10 generic categories and no transport class in the full-extension receipt.

implementation.stages: A fixed allowlist now records first-choice and restoration failure stages independently, including replacement validation, old-panel detach, Settings reopen, section open, preference observation, and panel recovery.
implementation.transport: The actual Settings native callback passes its existing transportFailureClass reader through both catches. Shared profile-reload-capture normalization maps unknown values to other and observer failures to unavailable.
implementation.redaction: Only allowlisted stages/classes reach fullExtensionReload and its failure criterion. Error messages, arbitrary properties, page text, URLs, and tokens are discarded.

forcing_assertions: Injected first-choice and restoration failures report different allowlisted stages and transport classes through the full-extension callback.
Injected exception messages/properties and unrecognized transport text containing a private URL/token do not appear in the retained result.
A source-path guard requires the actual native callback to supply transportFailureClass.

limitations: No browser or native run was performed; these diagnostics have no runtime acceptance credit.
The underlying cause of native run 37858551975 remains unknown until a separately authorized run produces the new safe stage evidence.
T40 downstream automatic capture remains unverified.
